connector.name: iFlow Search
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for iFlow Search web search, image search, and URL fetch tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package search-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zhengyanglsun account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IFLOW_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token for the iFlow Search API. Obtain one at https://platform.iflow.cn.

env.name: IFLOW_MCP_CLIENT
env.description: Optional MCP client slug forwarded to iFlow as the IFlow-MCP-Client header. Matches /^[a-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.

env.name: IFLOW_MCP_CLIENT_VERSION
env.description: Optional MCP client version forwarded to iFlow as the IFlow-MCP-Client-Version header. Only honored when IFLOW_MCP_CLIENT is also set.

env.name: IFLOW_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional override for the iFlow Search API base URL. Defaults to https://platform.iflow.cn.
